An archival film titled Bachcho Ke Beech Chacha Nehru offers a glimpse into how India's first Prime Minister, Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru, celebrated his birthday with children. The footage captures Nehru interacting with young children and talking to them about children's films, offering a glimpse into his bond with them and his interest in cinema for young audiences. Watch
